data.why: The app has no upload widget; a scientist browses files already staged in the server's own input/ folder, so the repo's tiny test.tsv plus a small synthetic VCF-style TSV (with a low-QUAL/low-depth outlier, a missing AF/DP value, and a deletion ALT) are seeded there, and app.py is replaced with a patched copy that resolves the Dockerfile's hardcoded /usr/src/app paths to the real checkout location so file browsing, search, and preset saving all work without Docker.

goals: Browse to a VCF/TSV/CSV file of variant calls and preview its columns
Build block-based filter criteria (column, operator, value, include N/As) to narrow variants by thresholds such as QUAL, DP, or AF
Retrieve and download the filtered variant subset for downstream analysis
Generate a customizable protein structure figure showing zygosity, domain/structure blocks, and marked features of interest for a gene
Save and reload figure-generator presets to reproduce a specific protein figure configuration

review.summary: The tree covers both tools the README describes (block-based filtering of variant tables with preview and download, and the per-allele protein figure generator with presets) at a sensible depth with general labels that don't use the tool's names, and most cited screens match their nodes. It needs small fixes before filing: two screens don't show what their nodes claim (027, 035), the preset and restyle tasks were not replayed, the broken 'exclude missing values' numeric filter is miscoded as an alternative instead of a limitation, and the goal implies a link from filtering to the figure that the app does not have.
